app.name: EOIP
app.synthetic_hint: All signals, zones, locations, teams and volumes in this MVP are made by the team for the demo. They are not Expo data or official figures.
app.proto_d: Sources: radio and Computer Vision cameras. All data is simulated for the demo.

login.brand_copy: Signals and field reports come together in one operational picture, helping teams make the right call with confidence and speed.
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your provisioned employee account to continue to the operations center.
login.local_note: Sign-in is checked against local employee accounts. No default account is provided.
login.invalid: Sign-in failed. Check the employee number and password.
login.csrf: This page expired. Reload it and try again.

overview.title: What needs a decision now?
overview.intro: EOIP brings signals and reports into one operational view, links reports about the same incident, and highlights what needs attention with the reason. The supervisor makes the final decision; the data in this presentation is simulated.
overview.notes: {noise} filtered as noise · {routine} routed to owning teams · {dup} duplicates merged
overview.now_empty: Nothing is waiting for a decision.
overview.now_empty_idle: Start the live event from Presenter tools to stream signals.
overview.decisions_empty: No decisions in this run yet.

map.title: Operations map
map.subtitle: Operational view of zones, locations and incidents. Select a zone or location for details.
map.illustrative: Illustrative operational map for the demo. It is not the official Expo 2030 site plan, and the location names are demo names.
map.select_hint: Select a zone or location to inspect its operational details.
map.active_empty: There are no active incidents right now.
map.selection_hint: Details update when you select a zone or location on the map.
map.legend_loc: Count = open incidents at the location
map.pick: Select a zone or location on the map.
map.zone_level_note: Occupancy and staffing are measured per zone, not per location.
map.no_locations: No locations are registered in this zone.
map.legend_note: Illustrative demo map — not an official Expo 2030 site plan

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.subtitle: Each incident is built from linked reports. Open one to see which reports were linked and why.
incidents.empty_hint: Clear the filters to see all incidents.
incidents.signals_sub: The triage view: what was filtered, routed, merged, linked or left for review.

incident.pick: Choose an incident from the Incidents page.
incident.not_found: This incident no longer exists. The demo may have been reset.
incident.score_hint: Rule score 0–1 for how strong the match is. It is not a trained model.
incident.status_banner_dismissed: Closed as a false alarm at {time}
incident.status_banner_escalated: Late · escalated to the managers at {time}; the decision is no longer with the duty officer.

decide.title: Decision support
decide.subtitle: Recommendations are rule-based. Figures are computed now from the current zone state. You decide, and every decision is logged with the verified employee.
decide.none: No open incidents need a decision.
decide.crew_note: Arrival times are estimates from the illustrative walkway map. Teams are a synthetic demo roster.
decide.no_team: No {kind} team is free right now
decide.no_simulation: No impact simulation for life-safety incidents: act first.
decide.note_placeholder: Add a note if you want
decide.note_required: Enter a reason for rejecting or closing as a false alarm first.
decide.human_note: EOIP recommends. The decision is yours, and it is logged.
decide.no_options: No automatic option for this state.
decide.no_options_hint: Use the crowd or staffing simulation to build one.
decide.done: {action} by {operator}. Saved to the decision log.

sim.aria: {zone}: now {now}%, without action {base}%, with this option {with}% of capacity
sim.staff_keys: Upper bar: before. Lower bar: after. Red means below the minimum.
sim.crowd_intro: Send part of the arrivals heading to {zone} to another zone and see both zones before and after.
sim.staff_intro: Move staff from one zone to another and see staffing against each zone's minimum.
sim.calc_note: Arithmetic flow model on the current zone state: arrivals minus people leaving or processed ({rate} per screener per minute at the gate) over {min} minutes. Not a crowd-dynamics model.
sim.add_hint: Adds it to Ranked options, where you approve or reject it.
sim.added: Option added to the ranked options.

log.title: Decision log
log.subtitle: Every approval, rejection and closure is stored with the verified employee name and number, time, reason, option, teams, simulation result and priority. Kept after demo resets and restarts.
log.identity_note: Employee identity comes from the authenticated server session. Historical decisions may not include an employee number.
log.empty_hint: Approvals, rejections and closures appear here.
log.run_earlier: Earlier runs (incident pages no longer exist; details are kept in the log)

demo.cv_replay_hint: Fallback: re-sends a recorded person-down detection, labelled as replay. No camera, no analysis.
demo.field_sample_text: Someone is unconscious in Zone B at the Main Walkway, we need an ambulance
demo.idle: Ready. Start the live event to stream signals. Reset keeps the decision log.
demo.tools_hint: Shift + D shows or hides them
demo.fire_sample_text: There is smoke in Zone A at the Food Court, next to the east exit
demo.grp_fallback: Fallbacks if the phone or camera fails
demo.not_started: Starts automatically when the screen opens
demo.confirm_new: A new event starts from zero (the decision log is kept).
demo.tools_set_hint: For the team during the demo · never deletes the decision log or accounts
demo.tools_note: “New event” starts from zero with the three stored cases; the decision log is kept.

reason.operational_cap: Held below Critical: operational, not life-safety
reason.verified_panel_alarm: Confirmed fire-panel alarm: treated as critical immediately
reason.eyewitness_report: Direct report from field staff (eyewitness): treated as critical immediately
reason.cv_person_down: The camera detected a person down (vision model): treated as critical immediately

corr.no_open_match: New incident: no open {type} incident in {zone} in the last {window_min} min
corr.different_location: Not linked to {code}: that one is at {location}, this report is at {this_location}
corr.location_not_stated: One report does not state the location ({location} known)
corr.same_source_update: Update from a source already linked

why.act_before_confirmation: Single source so far; for life safety, act before confirmation
why.nearest_available_team: {team} is the nearest free team, about {eta} min from {from_location}
why.no_team_available: No free {kind} team at the moment
why.routine_owner: Normal case owned by the {kind} team

check.outside_queue: About {people} people wait outside the gate
check.staff_no_flow_effect: In this model, extra staff in {zone} adds coverage but does not change visitor flow

step.dispatch_fire_team: Dispatch the fire response team to {place}
step.evacuate_zone: Evacuate {place} using PA announcements and stewards
step.medical_standby: Put a medical team on standby at the assembly point
step.dispatch_medical_team: Dispatch the nearest medical team to {place}
step.steward_secure_area: Send stewards to clear space around the person
step.prepare_ambulance_route: Keep the ambulance route to {place} clear
step.evacuate_location: Evacuate {place} only, not the whole zone
step.verify_on_site: Verify on site before any evacuation
step.request_ambulance: Request an ambulance from the Red Crescent

option.FIRE-01: Fire / smoke response: dispatch, notify, evacuate
option.MED-01: Medical response: dispatch, secure the area, ambulance route
option.redeploy_staff_desc: {to_zone} goes up to {staff_after} staff; {from_zone} gives up {staff_moved}.
option.divert_inflow_desc: Wayfinding screens and stewards send about {diverted_per_min} people per minute to {to_zone}.
option.meter_entry_desc: Slow the entry rate until the queue clears; about {held_per_min} people per minute wait outside.
option.route_team_desc: Normal case. The field team handles it; no ops-floor action needed.
option.FIRE-02: Send the fire team and evacuate the location only
option.FIRE-03: Send the fire team to verify first
option.MED-03: Send the medical team and call an ambulance
option.route_supervisor_desc: The supervisor checks on site and decides whether a specialist team is needed.
option.monitor_only_desc: The case stays under watch and is raised if a new report arrives.

side_effect.outside_queue: About {people} people wait outside the gate
side_effect.longer_walk: Longer walk for diverted visitors to {zone}

errors.network: Can't reach the EOIP server. Check that it is running.
errors.operator_required: Start a session with an operator name before recording a decision.
errors.incident_escalated: The response time ran out and the case was escalated to a manager; you can no longer decide it.
errors.recommendation_not_found: This option was replaced. Review the updated plan.
errors.team_unavailable: That team was just assigned elsewhere. The plan was updated with a free team.
errors.invalid_staff: That zone does not have that many staff.
errors.simulation_operational_only: Simulation is only for crowding and staffing incidents.
errors.text_required: Write or say the report first.
errors.needs_review: Choose the event type before sending.
errors.zone_required: Choose the zone the camera is looking at.
errors.location_not_in_zone: That location is not in the chosen zone.
errors.video_unreadable: This video could not be read. Try an MP4 file, or record a new clip.
errors.cv_unavailable: Camera analysis is not available on the server (the YOLO package is not installed).
errors.cv_model_unavailable: The YOLO model could not be loaded on the server. Check the weights file and the server log.
errors.session_not_found: The camera session ended. Start the camera again.
errors.invalid_frame: A camera frame could not be read.
errors.ui: The page failed to display: {detail}. Reload (Ctrl+F5); if it repeats, copy the error from the Console.
errors.unexpected_response: Unexpected response from the server. Reload the page or sign in again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.

field.title: Field reporting
field.subtitle: Field reports and live camera analysis.
field.mic_unavailable: Voice input isn't available in this browser. Type the report, or use your keyboard's dictation key.
field.mic_insecure: The microphone needs a secure (HTTPS) connection. Type the report, use your keyboard's dictation key, or reopen this page over HTTPS.
field.mic_error: Voice input stopped ({code}). You can type the report instead.
field.transcript_placeholder: e.g. Someone fell in Zone A near the Food Court
field.transcript_hint: Say what happened, the zone and the location. You can correct the text before checking it.
field.understood: What EOIP understood. Correct anything wrong before sending.
field.src_from_location: from the location (each location is in one zone)
field.reason_no_event: No event type recognised. Choose it.
field.reason_negated: The report says the event did NOT happen (negation). Nothing was assumed.
field.reason_multiple_events: More than one event mentioned ({events}). Choose the main one.
field.reason_multiple_zones: More than one zone mentioned. Choose one.
field.reason_multiple_locations: More than one location mentioned. Choose one.
field.reason_zone_location_mismatch: The location you said is not in the zone you said. Check both.
field.support_request: This is a support request (staff), not an incident report.
field.need_type: Choose the event type before sending.
field.zone_unknown_note: Without a zone the report is stored for review and not linked to an incident.
field.sent_review: Received and stored for review: zone not known, so it was not linked to an incident.
field.sample_note: Samples are for testing when the microphone is unavailable.
field.cam_kicker: Live analysis from the device camera
field.cam_intro: Use the phone or laptop camera directly. Keep the device steady and the whole person inside the frame. To try a recorded scene, play it on another screen in front of the lens.
field.cam_step_zone: Choose the zone and operational location.
field.cam_step_empty: Start analysis. The first start can take a few seconds while the YOLO model loads.
field.cam_step_clip: Then play the walking-then-fall scene on your phone with the person large and fully in frame.
field.cam_preview_note: Choose the zone and location, press “Start live camera” and allow the browser to use the camera.
field.cam_file_option: Upload a video for analysis (secondary option)
field.cam_file_help: Use this alternative if the live camera cannot start. Selecting or uploading a file does not create an alert; an alert appears only when the detector identifies a fall.
field.cam_honest: Detection uses a pretrained YOLO deep-learning model to find people, plus a posture rule (a standing person who lies horizontally for about a second). The model is general-purpose and was not trained on falls; accuracy has not been measured on real events. Results vary with camera angle, lighting and occlusion. Verify every alert manually.
field.cam_detected: The detector flagged a possible fall ({origin}; experimental detection score {pct}%). Alert sent to operations: {code} ({priority}).
field.cam_no_fall: Analysis ended without creating an alert for this clip.
field.cam_too_short: The video is too short to analyse.
field.cam_s_file_ready: Choose the zone and the recorded test clip.
field.cam_s_insecure: The browser cannot access the camera over this connection. Open the site on localhost or over HTTPS.
field.cam_s_denied: Camera permission was not granted ({code}). Allow it in the browser site settings and try again.
field.cam_s_state_alerted: Live analysis. A report was created for this case; it will not repeat while the person stays down.
field.cam_s_stopped: Demo ended. Analysed {n} frames and recorded {alerts} alerts.
field.cam_s_file_done: Analysed {s} s of video ({frames} frames): {n} detections.
field.cam_s_cv_unavailable: Camera analysis is not available on this server (YOLO package missing).
field.cam_once_note: One report was sent for this case. It will not repeat while the person stays down; detection re-arms after they get up.
field.cam_s_need_location: Choose the location inside the zone before starting.
field.cam_s_unsupported: This browser does not support camera access. Use a recent Chrome, Edge or Safari.
field.cam_s_no_camera: No camera was found on this device ({code}).
field.cam_s_busy: The camera is in use by another app or could not start ({code}). Close other apps and try again.
field.cam_alert_summary: The detector sent a “{event}” report to the operations center for verification.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Account, language, appearance and report sources.
settings.appearance_d: Your choice is saved on this device.
settings.language_d: The interface language and direction change immediately.
settings.theme_d: Your choice is remembered on this browser.
settings.sources_d: Sources connected to the platform in this prototype. Information only.
settings.src_radio_d: Voice reports from field supervisors are turned into text, and the event, zone and location are extracted.
settings.src_radio_l: The phone works as the field supervisor's radio|Arabic and English speech to text|Automatic linking to open incidents

esc.log_detail: Decision later than the response time ({min} min) · {label}
esc.toast: {title} · {place}: response time ran out, escalated to {code} · {role}

esc.set_note: Counted from when the case opened (or was raised to its priority). If it runs out before a decision, the case leaves the officer's screen, the approve button disappears, and the log shows «Late · escalated to L1», rising with time. Illustrative MVP values.
